pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal geometries with sharp pixel gradients at the edges. Patch area is significantly smaller on the lower neck, expanding into larger, more elongated rectangular and trapezoidal shapes on the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Negative-space network of light pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junctions are predominantly T-shaped and Y-shaped nodes. Pixel thickness remains relatively constant across the mid-flank with high connectivity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Serrated 1D contour along the upper neck and shoulder with low-amplitude and high-frequency oscillations created by individual hair tufts against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, vertically oriented dark linear mark is visible on the mid-flank, spanning across one light corridor and partially into the adjacent patches, consistent with a healed scar.
